prompt:
Subject: Ballerina in morning light

Main Subject: The person is placed large in the center of the screen. A vertical full-body photo of a woman in a pale pink costume kneeling in a ballet room with wooden floors, extending her arms long up and down. Light from a large window and shadows on the floor create a stage-like silence.

Person/Expression: Face tilted down, eyes closed, with a relaxed and gentle expression. Small oval outline, long closed eyelashes, thin bridge of the nose, and pale coral lips. Light brown hair is gathered in a high loose bun, leaving thin bangs and wisps along the cheeks.

Clothing/Pose: A pale pink thin-strapped leotard with delicate floral lace and transparency from the chest to the torso, with a thin chiffon wrap skirt falling from the waist. One knee on the floor, the opposite knee bent high and placed in front. One arm extended in an arc over the head, the other arm down diagonally close to the floor. Both feet in pale pink pointe shoes.

Background/Light: Window on the left, desk on the right, bar in the background, with soft key light from the left. A large window and white curtains on the left, a wooden bar along the wall, and a desk with flowers and framed artwork in the back right. Warm morning sun shines from the left, creating long shadows and golden reflections on the floor.

Composition/Camera: Focus on the person, fitting the whole body in the frame, naturally blurring the background. The person appears large in the center. 2:3 vertical composition, full-body shot from the floor to the raised fingertips. The person is centered, emphasizing the S-shaped flow from upper arms to legs. Slightly lower than natural eye level, background is gently blurred.

Texture/Style: Photorealistic live-action photo. Realistic dance photography utilizing soft backlighting. Delicately depicts the textures of lace, chiffon, satin shoes, and polished wooden floors.

Negative: Do not flip the arm and leg poses horizontally.
